paragraphs: Day shifts include coordination drills and response-plan practice; night shifts center on monitoring large displays. During an incident, specialists align response authority with each unit and verify that orders are transmitted correctly. Afterward, they review every break in the command chain.

In short, they deliver clear orders amid confusion. Tasks include monitoring situations, transmitting orders, managing communications, verifying plans, directing responses, and conducting after-action reviews. They combine judgment with command-link discipline at the center of operations.
